app_tagline: Ask your organization's documents and get answers with sources.
auth_login_subtitle: Use your account at your organization.
auth_mfa_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
auth_enroll_description: Required for administrator accounts. Scan the code below with the authenticator app on your phone (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
auth_enroll_qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
auth_enroll_manual: If you cannot scan it, enter this key in the app manually:
auth_enroll_code_label: The 6-digit code shown by the app
auth_recovery_description: If you lose your phone or passkey, you can sign in with these codes. Each code works only once. Store them somewhere safe; this screen will not be shown again.
home_next: Ask a question about your documents. The answer shows the sources it rests on.
error_invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error_invalid_code: The code is invalid or has expired.
error_session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error_network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin_group_no_members: This group has no members yet.
admin_group_select: Select a group to see its members.
admin_collection_select: Select a collection to edit its access.
admin_grants_empty: Nobody can access this collection yet. Everyone, administrators included, needs a grant.
error_email_taken: An account with this email address already exists.
error_password_too_short: The password must be at least 15 characters.
error_password_contains_context: The password must not contain the email name, the person's name or the organization's name.
error_last_administrator: At least one active administrator must remain.
error_conflict: This name or entry already exists.
error_not_found: Not found; the page may be out of date.
error_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
account_password_hint: At least 15 characters; at least 8 with two-step verification.
account_password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account_password_changed: Your password was changed. Your sessions on other devices were ended.
admin_reset_password_done: The password was set and the user's sessions were ended. Give the new password to the user through a safe channel.
admin_reset_mfa_explain: Removes the authenticator and the recovery codes. Use this only when the user has lost both.
admin_reset_mfa_done: Two-step verification was removed and the user's sessions were ended. If the role requires it, the user sets it up again at the next sign-in.
error_own_account: Use My account for your own account.
auth_mfa_passkey_description: Confirm with your passkey. If you cannot, enter one of your recovery codes.
auth_enroll_passkey_description: A passkey is kept on this device or in your password manager and is confirmed with your fingerprint, face or PIN.
account_passkey_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
error_passkey_cancelled: The passkey request was cancelled or timed out.
error_passkey_failed: The passkey could not be verified.
error_last_second_factor: Administrators must keep at least one second factor.
error_passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys are not set up on this server.
library_no_collections: You have no collections yet. An administrator can give you access, or an editor can create one.
library_pick_collection: Choose a collection to see its documents.
library_empty: This collection has no documents yet.
library_drop_hint: Or drop files here. PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and images.
library_read_only: You can read this collection but not add to it.
failure_unreadable: The file could not be read.
failure_too_many_pages: The file has too many pages.
failure_sheet_too_large: A sheet in the file is too large.
failure_suspicious_package: The file expands to an unusual size and was not opened.
failure_internal_error: Processing failed. Try uploading it again.
error_file_too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit.
error_unknown_type: This file type is not supported.
error_legacy_office: Old Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) and password-protected Office files are not supported. Save it as .docx, .xlsx or .pptx.
error_duplicate_document: The same file is already in this collection.
chat_queued: The model is busy; you are number {position} in line
chat_retrying: A number did not match the sources; the answer is being written again
chat_insufficient: The sources found do not answer this question.
chat_failed: The answer could not be written. The sources above are what the search found.
chat_stripped: Sentences stating numbers that are not in the sources were removed.
chat_source_gone: This source is no longer available to you.
chat_warning_embedding_unavailable: Search by meaning is unavailable; results are by words only.
chat_warning_reranking_unavailable: Reranking is unavailable; results are in a rougher order.
viewer_ocr: This page's text was read by OCR and may contain errors.
